text: Daily review: added IberSPEECH 2026 programme and presenter information to the conference listing. Detailed sessions, oral/poster guidelines and social activities are now available; the programme remains preliminary and registration is still closed.

Daily review: updated the SIG-CSLP Assembly / Closing Ceremony on 16 Nov to 17:00–18:00, as now printed in the ISCSLP programme. Added AISV 2027 deadlines for author attendance confirmation (8 Dec 2026) and online registration (21 Feb 2027).

Daily review: added Haopeng Geng’s 7 Dec SLaTE webinar and the 10 Jan 2027 abstract deadline for the LV International Philological Conference. Updated the SLaTE series to show its announced session and added the IberSPEECH proceedings ISSN.
Aligned the main navigation as Upcoming, Lectures, SIGs and Maintenance; retired the standalone Library / ISCA resources section and added linked video preview cards to Lectures.

Daily review: confirmed Pierre Fernandez’s 7 Oct 2026 SPSC webinar date from the restored official index and added the date to the talk list. Clarified that Yanyun Wang’s published 21 Oct schedule does not confirm that the event took place.
Daily review: updated IberSPEECH 2026 registration to reflect the organizer’s announcement that all places are filled and registration is closed.

Removed the duplicate Workshop & conference recordings block from Talks & tutorials in both editions, retaining the individual talk index, series collections and underlying recording records. Clarified that Content reviewed records a source check by Xiaojin, the AI maintainer, rather than a review or approval by ISCA or SIG representatives.
Shortened the Fancy edition address to the site root, retaining existing record-page links and the shared directory data.
Added a searchable index of individual talks, with dated recordings first and series collections retained. Simplified maintenance and source-access explanations across both editions.

Corrected seminar and recording descriptions against original sources; added SynSIG recordings and the SPSC Pierre Fernandez recording; clarified uncertain SPSC and IWSLT dates, restored ISCA’s SLPAT website link, corrected the VoxSRC report count, and refreshed registration, archive and event details across the directory following a reader report.

Connected the Fancy and Classic editions, expanded search across all directory pages, clarified the daily collection and planned SIG representative review, checked the current group count against ISCA, and removed SCOOT links. Simplified the record interface and made event and series markers explicit.

Daily review: added the SSW14 keynote lineup and linked its speaker page. Updated ISCSLP 2026 listings to reflect the detailed programme, and changed the wording for the past AISV course-registration and Odyssey special-issue submission deadlines.
Daily review: linked the AVSP 2026 proceedings in ISCA Archive. Updated the wording for the 27 October Milan oral-archives study day and the opening of TAI 2027 abstract submissions.

Daily review: refreshed the Speech Prosody lecture listings and added the free-admission reservation requirement for the Milan oral-archives study day. Marked the previously announced IWSLT 2027 task-decision date as unconfirmed because the current call no longer includes that timetable.

Daily review: refreshed the SPSC webinar listings after the 7 October date passed. Yanyun Wang’s 21 October webinar is now the next listed session; the earlier Pierre Fernandez listing remains available on the organizer’s page.
Daily review: VoicePrivacy 2026 results and system descriptions are available; added the organizer’s presentation index with seven team videos, papers and audio samples.
Daily review: the provisional ISCSLP 2026 programme now holds the SIG-CSLP Assembly together with the closing ceremony, 16:30–17:00 on 16 Nov 2026.

The sidebar link to SCOOT 2.0 now opens its learning-resource catalog: since 3 October 2026 SCOOT covers learning resources only and links here for SIG content. The atlas's former address (speechlab0210.github.io/isca-sig-atlas) now redirects here directly.
Daily review: added the recording of the 20 Aug 2026 SPSC webinar (Guangzhi Sun and Xuenan Xu) and noted the IberSPEECH 2026 late-registration deadline (17 Nov).

Started a daily collection and review of the source pages, now 148 pages including the activity and event pages cited in the directory. Pages that changed are compared with the last review, and updates found this way are published only after they are confirmed on a first-party source; a few SIGs also get a targeted search each day, in rotation. GitHub Issues are turned off; corrections are handled by email.

Reviewed all 20 SIG profiles against their official sources. Corrected dates, links and descriptions; added 17 dated events (including the October 2026 ISCA Distinguished Lectures), 10 recording links and 3 recording collections; removed one superseded webinar announcement; and trimmed internal research notes. Re-ran the source checks: 74 of 74 pages retrieved, including two reported earlier as unavailable.

Changed how the directory is maintained: source pages are no longer collected on a daily schedule and are re-checked when the directory is reviewed. Mail to speechlab0210@gmail.com is checked three times a day, and senders receive a reply describing any change. Improved keyboard navigation, search accuracy, colour contrast and small-screen navigation.
Launched a standalone edition of the SCOOT 2.0 SIG collection, preserving all 20 groups, 8 series and 10 event recording collections. The SCOOT original is unchanged.

Collected 51 primary source pages (49 retrieved, 2 unavailable). Added October SPSC speakers, AISV’s November course and 2027 conference, and SSW14. Corrected ISCSLP 2026 to 14–17 November. Past calendar entries are now separated automatically.

Updated the SLaTE website to its Google Sites home, which lists the current board, workshops and webinar series. Kept unavailable sources and dated descriptions visible rather than treating a failed check as no activity.
